claimed_scopes.command: ./bin/oya vcs --format json claim --agent codex-leader --intent CS-CLOUD-KMS-004-manifest-gate-coherence microservices/cloud-kms/manifest.json tasks/plan.md tasks/todo.md evidence/multispectrum/cs-cloud-kms-manifest-gate-coherence-20260523.json evidence/audit-chain.jsonl

summary: Reconcile the Cloud KMS manifest to implemented evidence. The manifest now names the implemented KMS domain/API/provider-adapter crates, limits layers to adapter/api/domain, replaces stale doc-backed capabilities with code-backed capabilities, empties unmeasured SLO claims, records hyperscaler invariant non-claims, maps audit-chain seal events to the implemented KMS evidence event id shape, removes DR/sharding/IaC invocation claims without implementation evidence, and adds newer applicable ADR references.

baseline_diff.before: The Cloud KMS manifest claimed only domain/API crates while listing non-existent app/rest/sdk/usecase/worker layers, doc-backed envelope/HSM capabilities, a measured-looking SLO without runtime metrics, DR/failover and sharding automation declarations without implementation evidence, and stale ADR coverage ending at ADR-0345.
baseline_diff.after: The manifest advertises only implemented local KMS domain/API/adapter crates and code-backed capabilities, keeps public OpenAPI version pins, marks SLO/DR/sharding/capacity/runtime surfaces as explicit non-claims where evidence is absent, and cites ADR-0346/0348/0349/0351 as newer applicable decisions.

repo_authority_used.establishes: Public API version carriers and N=3 date-version support are required for public API manifests.
Local verification claims must mirror CI-class gates or explicitly record gaps.
Sharding automation is a named manifest surface, but implementation/evidence must exist before it is claimed as operative.
CI/CD substrate claims require Jenkins/ArgoCD evidence; absent runtime surfaces stay unclaimed.
Cross-cell rebalancing and cell lifecycle are owned by separate microservices; Cloud KMS must not claim those workflows.
CS-CLOUD-KMS-004 acceptance requires implemented-only crates/layers/capabilities/contracts and explicit SLO/capacity/DR/sharding non-claims.

implementation_notes: Kept tenant_version_pinning and OpenAPI contract declarations because CS-CLOUD-KMS-001 verifies all manifest-declared versions at the API boundary.
Added adapter crates to bounded_contexts and capabilities because OCI/OpenBao deterministic provider translators are implemented and tested.
Removed app/rest/sdk/usecase/worker layers because no Cloud KMS app crate, REST server runtime, SDK crate, usecase crate, or worker exists in this slice.
Replaced measured-looking SLO and invariant coverage assertions with explicit not_claimed_cs_cloud_kms_004 text until metrics, Prometheus/OpenSLO, and burn-rate evidence exist.
Removed DR and sharding automation blocks rather than leaving disabled-yet-audit-emitting declarations that imply runtime control-plane ownership without implementation evidence.
Cleared iac_module_invocations because this service has no per-service IaC wrapper invocation evidence in the implemented KMS surface.

findings: The change deletes false manifest claims instead of adding placeholder files or new abstraction layers.
SLO, circuit-breaker, rate-limit, golden-signal, burn-rate, DR, and sharding surfaces are no longer claimed without measured runtime evidence.
The coherence check fails the prior manifest and passes the reconciled manifest, preventing false-green claim drift.
Capabilities now point directly to code files future maintainers can inspect rather than stale feature matrices or runbooks.
JSON parse, custom coherence, architecture, API semver, planning, dependency, and scoped honest-claims checks were run.

alternatives_named: Add placeholder app/sdk/worker files to satisfy manifest claims
Leave aspirational SLO/DR/sharding declarations in place
Reduce the manifest to implemented evidence and explicit non-claims
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: The selected path aligns the manifest with current evidence without manufacturing placeholder code or false runtime assertions.
rejected_reasons: Placeholder layers would create thin false-green code and violate the current substance bar.
Aspirational runtime declarations would continue to overstate implementation readiness.

findings: Audit-chain seal events now map to metadata-only KMS evidence events rather than DR/failover doctrine events that are not implemented.
Measured SLO claims were removed until runtime metrics and burn-rate evidence exist.
The manifest no longer implies DR drill evidence, audit-chain deploy/failover events, or sharding audit events that were not emitted.
The change is manifest/task/evidence-only and can be reverted independently of KMS code.
Observability claims are explicit non-claims until Cloud KMS metrics/OpenSLO/PrometheusRule evidence exists.
Operators can distinguish implemented local KMS capabilities from future runtime/IaC/DR/sharding work.
Manifest layers now reflect the implemented clean architecture boundary: domain, API, and provider adapters only.

remaining_risks: The repo-wide design/spec maturity gate still fails for pre-existing missing surfaces across many microservices.
Cloud KMS still lacks live provider/HSM execution, audit-chain persistence wiring, measured SLO/burn-rate rules, DR drill evidence, and sharding automation; these are explicit non-claims after CS004.
Python jsonschema is unavailable in this local environment, so manifest schema validation used json.tool plus custom coherence checks as the next-best local validation.
